title: invalidateQuery
subtitle: Invalidate and refetch a query
description: Mark a query as stale and trigger a refetch. Useful for refreshing data after mutations or when you know the data is outdated.

rows.name: queryKey
rows.description: Unique identifier for the query. Can be a string, array, or object. Or a partial key to invalidate all queries that start with the given key.

returns.description: No return value. Invalidation is synchronous, but triggers async refetch.

dos: Use after mutations to refresh related data
donts: Don't use for initial data loading

callouts.title: Post-Mutation Invalidation
callouts.content: invalidateQuery is commonly used after mutations to ensure related data is refreshed and up-to-date.

callouts.title: Performance Consideration
callouts.content: Invalidating queries triggers refetches. Be mindful of the impact on performance and network usage.
